- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Policy options include:

  2. The EU should play a greater role in health policy by providing funding and technical assistance to member states to help them improve the quality and accessibility of healthcare services.
  3. The EU should establish a European Health Union to coordinate the health policies of member states and address common public health issues.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 1 advantages: sharing best practices, sharing the burden of healthcare costs, improving quality and accessibility of healthcare services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 1 disadvantages: requires voluntary cooperation, difficult to reach agreements, may not address public health issues at the EU level.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Option 2 advantages: supports member states, provides funding for infrastructure and research, offers technical assistance for policy implementation.
